Quick note ahead of our demo scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Our security team requires that external vendors complete the onboarding portal before product walkthroughs that include an environment preview. Items we need from MedLogix:

- Signed mutual NDA (or confirmation that your procurement team has an equivalent on file)

- SSO metadata or a confirmed test account for our test environment

I attached a short checklist and step-by-step link to the portal to speed things up. If procurement is still reviewing the paperwork, we can easily move the demo to later this week — just let me know what works.

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick update and for forwarding procurement's note.

Just to clarify our requirements (so we don't cause unnecessary back-and-forth):

1) The mutual NDA is required only to review the environment that contains sample customer data. We can run a restricted demo (screenshare of UI with redacted data) without the NDA if that would help keep momentum.
2) The vendor questionnaire is a short form (5–7 fields) that our security team uses to triage; no heavy attestation required for the initial walkthrough, but we do need a completed form before any extended trial or eval that involves uploading data.
3) SSO metadata is for automated provisioning — it is not mandatory for the demo. A test account will suffice.

If MedLogix prefers to keep the NDA redlines conversation in parallel, we can:
- Do a focused 45-minute demo tomorrow that avoids the environment preview and sensitive topics, OR
- Reschedule to a time after procurement finalizes (we can be flexible).

Open slots on our side:
- Wed, 28 Jul 2026 between 1:00–4:00pm PT
- Thu, 29 Jul 2026 between 9:30–12:00pm PT

I also pasted a one-click onboarding link below that pre-populates the questionnaire for MedLogix to review — should save a few rounds.

Portal: https://vendor-onboard.redwood.example/medlogix/portal
DocuSign (onboarding): https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC-Redwood-Onboarding

If you want the redlined NDA back to our legal team for comment, Monica can coordinate offline.

Best,
Markus Klein
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
